publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Review-only scientific algorithmic anatomical or pathology reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, patient record, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: NLM MeSH supplies controlled condition identity and scope; official NIH sources supply conservative anatomical and communication boundaries only. No source image or design is copied.

reviewStandard: Current controlled condition identity, anatomically conservative and non-diagnostic representation, non-stigmatizing communication, complete pale edge field, crop-safe geometry, and exact prompt must be frozen before exactly one generation call per cleared route. Observed output controls later metadata.
promotionRule: No output may receive a registry key, public master, derivative, endpoint, schema node, or sitemap entry before immutable native-resolution review and exact-hash Control Tower acceptance.

assets.representationBoundary: Neutral pregnancy and glucose-regulation anatomy; no fetus, pre-existing diabetes, asserted mechanism, complication, severity, treatment, prognosis, or diagnosis.
Representative diffuse thyroid and TSH-receptor-autoantibody orientation; no universal goiter or ophthalmopathy, hormone measurement, severity, treatment response, or diagnosis.
Representative autoimmune follicular-injury orientation; no histology claim, universal enlargement or atrophy, hormone measurement, stage, severity, treatment response, or diagnosis.
Broad etiology-neutral liver-inflammation orientation; no specific viral or nonviral cause, chronicity, fibrosis, severity, prognosis, or diagnosis.
Representative follicular occlusion and limited tunnel architecture; no universal lesion, contagious process, asserted cause, Hurley stage, severity, treatment response, or diagnosis.
Neutral HIV and immune-system orientation covering the spectrum that includes AIDS; no transmission, viral process, HIV type, cell count, viral load, treatment status, stage, prognosis, or diagnosis.
